name: tinyzkp
display_name: TinyZKP - Proof Receipts for AI Agents
description: Mint transparent STARK proof receipts for supported state-transition workflows as an MCP tool call. No trusted setup; hash-based verification. Live self-serve template: accumulator_step; accumulator_step available now. Verification is free; Free includes 100 evaluation receipts/month. Private-input, custom, on-chain, zkVM, and zkML claims require review.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List supported proof templates with lifecycle status, summaries, and tags.

tools.name: describe_template
tools.description: Get the full parameter schema and cost category for a template.

tools.name: list_workloads
tools.description: List registered workload IDs for supported long-running or reviewed proving workflows.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Report server capabilities, product boundary, supported transports, and plan limits.

tools.name: prove_template
tools.description: Submit a proof job using a named template (recommended path).

tools.name: prove_workload
tools.description: Submit a supported workload or Compute proof job.

tools.name: poll_job
tools.description: Poll the status of a submitted prove job.

tools.name: verify_proof
tools.description: Verify a proof. Always free; never charges quota.

tools.name: get_proof
tools.description: Retrieve the proof bytes for a completed job.

tools.name: get_proof_summary
tools.description: Retrieve a compact summary (digest, sizes, timing) for a completed job.

remote.claude: claude mcp add --transport http tinyzkp https://mcp.tinyzkp.com

auth.notes: Public endpoint, capped by HC_MCP_MAX_INFLIGHT. Authenticated requests get per-plan rate limits matching the HTTP API ladder. Use https://tinyzkp.com/agent-policy for receipt mint/verify policy.
